<placeName>

<placeName> (place name) contains an absolute or relative place name.
Attributes Global attributes and those inherited from data, names
Example 
<placeName>
  <settlement>Rochester</settlement>
  <region>New York</region>
</placeName>
 
<placeName>
  <geogName>Arrochar Alps</geogName>
  <region>Argylshire</region>
</placeName>
 
<placeName>
  <distance>10 miles</distance>
  <offset>Northeast of</offset>
  <settlement>Attica</settlement>
</placeName>
Module Declared in file teind2; Additional tag set for Names and Dates: enabled by TEI.names.dates
